name: Shoulder Shrug
description: Standing tall with your arms relaxed, lift both shoulders up toward your ears, hold for a count of five, then let them drop. It stretches and strengthens the shoulders and neck.

source.title: UMM Health: Shoulder shrug exercise
source.note: Described in our own words. The source does it sitting in a chair; this is the same move standing.

setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, weight even.
cues: Let them drop all the way.

prescription.note: Hold each shrug for a count of 5. Keep your head and neck still and relaxed; move only your shoulders.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides.

keyframes.name: Shrug
keyframes.cue: Lift both shoulders up toward your ears.

keyframes.name: Release
keyframes.cue: Let your shoulders drop and relax.
